newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux says buys not in 2 year plan.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux says buys not in 2 year plan.

text.p: Household appliance maker Electrolux said on Thursday that its two-year restructuring programme did not include plans for any acquisitions.
However, chief executive Michael Treschow said the company was keeping an eye on all alternatives.
"Acquisitions are not included in this two-year plan but at the same time we are looking at different alternatives," Treschow told a news conference.
"I'm not excluding acquisitions but now we are focusing on seeing through the restructuring plan," he said.
Treschow also said the company expected the European white goods market to remain flat this year.
He said the period March-April looked a bit better while May was somewhat worse.
